is_preferred_sequencer.description:
Determines whether this sequencer is *regular* or *preferred*.

Batches from the preferred sequencer are always processed first in
block, which means the preferred sequencer can guarantee soft
confirmation time for transactions.

seq_da_address.description: The Data Availability (DA) address of the sequencer.

seq_rollup_address.description: The rollup address of the sequencer.

MockAddress.description: Mock address; 32 bytes in hex-encoded format
